name: Practice Buffer
description: Click buffer for practice: a jump pressed a few frames early is applied when you land or touch an orb.

enabled.name: Enabled
enabled.description: Turn the click buffer on or off.

practice-only.name: Practice mode only
practice-only.description: Only buffer clicks in practice mode. Keep this on so you never record a normal run with the buffer active.

buffer-frames.name: Buffer (frames)
buffer-frames.description: How early a click can be, in 60 FPS frames (1 frame is about 16.7 ms).

buffer-orbs.name: Buffer orbs
buffer-orbs.description: Early clicks activate an orb you touch within the buffer window.

orb-frames.name: Orb buffer (frames)
orb-frames.description: Separate, shorter window for orbs. A press only activates an orb if you touch it within this many frames (60 FPS frames). Keep it low so you don't hit orbs you meant to skip.

buffer-ground.name: Buffer ground jumps
buffer-ground.description: Early clicks make you jump when you land within the buffer window (cube, ball, robot, spider).
